reasoning_content:
I see! There are TWO areloria directories:
1. `/opt/areloria` - the actual deployment dir (different from /root/opt/areloria)
2. `/root/opt/areloria` - where we've been making changes

The PM2 is using `/opt/areloria` as the CWD but we fixed `/root/opt/areloria`. The ecosystem.config.cjs has `cwd: /opt/areloria`. Let me also fix that one!

Wait, but the error was showing `/opt/areloria/server/package.json contains "type": "module"`. So the issue is at `/opt/areloria`, not `/root/opt/areloria`. Let me check what's in /opt/areloria.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check /opt/areloria/server/package.json
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -5 /opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("=== /opt/areloria server/package.json ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Fix it
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '/\"type\": \"module\"/d' /opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("Fixed /opt/areloria/server/package.json")

# Also check root package.json
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -5 /opt/areloria/package.json")
print("\n=== /opt/areloria package.json ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Fix root package.json too
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '/\"type\": \"module\"/d' /opt/areloria/package.json")
print("Fixed /opt/areloria/package.json")

# Delete and restart PM2 completely
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all && pm2 start /opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env && sleep 8 && pm2 list")
print("\n=== PM2 Status ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
PYEOF
